issues: 底色是无色相的 #050505 纯中性黑，线全是纯白，整片像黑白线框图，没有配色系统
标签只有一个白方块加一行裸等宽字，背后的线直接从字上穿过，可读性和质感都弱
标签只做 12f 线性淡入，没有入场动作，也没有图钉与文字的先后层次
支流从源头到汇点亮度一样，读不出“往主干流”的方向；生长期笔尖没有任何引导
大面积暗部没有颗粒，渐变容易出色带；没有导出时长常量，工作台按默认值猜成 150f，截掉了交棒段
changes: 改为带冷色相的深场（#0d111b→#05070b）加汇点方向一团极淡的蓝色地光；线改冷白 #e2e8ff，强调色只用柔和长春花蓝 #9aabff（主干辉光、图钉、汇点）
支流描边用沿流向的渐变（源头 0.22 → 汇入处 1），主干在汇点之后染上强调色
生长期笔尖加一颗小光点（核 + 强调色柔晕），按弧长表取点，和 draw-on 严格同步，到终点前淡出
标签改成两段式入场：图钉 overshoot 弹出、外圈细环扩散后收成常驻；3f 后 ID 胶囊（深色半透明衬底 + 发丝线 + 强调色点）上浮 10px 并去模糊
导出 DATAVIZ_LANDSCAPE_OPEN_DURATION = 165，交棒段完整；开场 12f 从深场里浮出；屏幕空间加暗角（0.55）和 0.09 soft-light 颗粒
issuesEn: The background was a hueless #050505 and every line pure white, so the shot read as a monochrome wireframe with no color system
Labels were a bare white square plus raw monospace text with lines running straight through the glyphs, weak in both legibility and finish
Labels only did a 12f linear fade, with no entrance motion and no ordering between pin and text
Tributaries had the same brightness from source to merge, so there was no sense of flowing into the trunk, and nothing marked the drawing tip during growth
Large dark areas had no grain, inviting banding; there was no exported duration constant, so the workbench defaulted to 150f and cut off the handoff
changesEn: Cool-hued deep field (#0d111b to #05070b) with a faint blue ground glow toward the merge point; lines are cool white #e2e8ff, and the only accent is a soft periwinkle #9aabff (trunk glow, pins, merge point)
Tributary strokes use a gradient along the flow (0.22 at the source to 1 at the merge), and the trunk takes on the accent hue past the merge point
Each drawing tip carries a small light point (core plus accent halo), placed with an arc-length table so it stays exactly on the draw-on head and fades before the end

Labels enter in two stages: the pin pops with overshoot and its outer ring expands, then settles to a persistent thin ring; 3f later the ID capsule (dark translucent backing, hairline, accent dot) rises 10px while de-blurring
Exported DATAVIZ_LANDSCAPE_OPEN_DURATION = 165 so the handoff plays in full; the opening fades up from the dark over 12f; added a screen-space vignette (0.55) and 0.09 soft-light grain
